description: Guard editable-curve simplification using whole-weave drift and original-mask error, while retaining strict geometry checks and shared spans.

corpus.method: Fixed saved geometry, same unforced symmetry for all three conversions. Raw means tolerance zero. Previous converter loaded from Git; its dependencies must be unchanged. Target error uses the original mask and free-border weights. Independent coverage uses an antialiased 4x Resvg image averaged onto original pixels. No fitting or solve timing in this replay; conversion timers exclude scoring and SVG rendering.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

fallback.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

limits: Raster comparisons are sampled checks, not a continuous proof of zero seams. Exact shared controls provide exact cancellation.
Conversion baseline includes normalization and accepted symmetry correction.
Old engine solve timings are reused only after verifying unchanged source hashes; they are not new measurements.
Saved-geometry timing and comparisons isolate conversion. Fresh browser runs use time-limited optimization and can follow different later checkpoints.
